title: T06 Planning and Reflection Data Contract
description: Cloudflare D1 SQLite contract for the Pages Functions implementation.

timezone.overdue_rule: Count only status=todo tasks with non-empty due_date earlier than the current Asia/Seoul calendar date.

columns.title: TEXT max 240
columns.due_date: Seoul calendar date TEXT or empty
columns.deleted_at: UTC timestamp TEXT or null; soft-deleted tasks excluded from listing and review

columns.target_plan_id: TEXT NOT NULL and different from source_plan_id

review_calculations.cohort: Non-deleted tasks whose parent plan overlaps the selected interval (plan.start_date <= to and plan.end_date >= from).
review_calculations.completed_count: Cohort tasks with current status done.
review_calculations.overdue_count: Cohort tasks with current status todo and due_date before Asia/Seoul today.
review_calculations.blocked_count: Distinct cohort tasks with at least one execution record whose trimmed blocker_reason is non-empty.
review_calculations.estimated_minutes: Sum of estimated_minutes for cohort tasks.
review_calculations.actual_minutes: Sum of actual_minutes for all execution records attached to cohort tasks.
review_calculations.difference_minutes: actual_minutes minus estimated_minutes; empty sums are zero.
review_calculations.completion_idempotency: A unique client UUID idempotency key plus D1 batch transaction. Repeated requests cannot create a second record or mark an already completed task twice.
